assumptions: The declaration was written against the stated base.
The observed worktrees were committed or quiescent for both Git observations.
Writers that cannot be attributed to a unit are unknown, not violations; on a shared working tree no change is attributed to any unit.
assurance.domain: Committed or quiesced Git state of at most 32 units in one repository; file-level resources.
assurance.evidenceMethod: Declaration validation and expansion, and the bounded read-only Git adapter run in-process by the bundled CLI over committed or quiesced worktrees; the plugin MCP is not used.
assurance.executionContract: Read-only; no launch, message, resume, grant, edit, merge or write other than the explicit new output path; executionAuthorization is false.
assurance.observationContract: Added and modified files are write effects; deletions, renames, binaries, symlinks and submodules are unknown; reads are never observed; Bash in flight, MCP effects and uncommitted work of active writers are not observed; absent observations are not-observed and never mean clean.
assurance.property: Exact repository-relative path agreement between declared ownership and file-level Git effects at the named snapshot; not semantic commutation, hunk-level safety or order independence.

limits: A shared working tree was supplied: no change is attributed to any unit and no per-unit comparison is made for it.
